question: Which persons born in an Ādiśaiva family are eligible to assist in these rites?
premises: Eligibility is linked to birth in an Ādiśaiva family.
Brāhmaṇas born in that family are included.
Kṣatriyas and Vaiśyas born in that family are included.
inference: Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas born in an Ādiśaiva family are eligible.
plain_english: Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas born in an Ādiśaiva family.
